author: Jonas Maes
text: Heads-up team: from 2026 the way we calculate double holiday pay for a part-time employee who leaves mid-year changed. When someone had multiple part-time fractions during the qualifying year you now use the time-weighted average occupation fraction, not the fraction at the leaving date. The BE Holiday Pay Procedure still needs updating to reflect this departure holiday pay change.

author: An Peeters
text: Thanks Jonas, good catch. I'll fold that into v5 of the procedure. Until then use the time-weighted average for leavers.

author: Marie Dubois
text: Reminder: December cut-off is the 12th this year, not the 18th. Please get all departures in early.

author: Tom Verhoeven
text: Quick q: for Brouwerij Vandamme blue-collar staff, is holiday pay via the holiday fund or direct? Client onboarding asked.

author: An Peeters
text: Via the holiday fund (RJV) for JC 118 blue-collar. Office staff JC 200 are paid directly. It's in the Vandamme client rules doc.

author: Jonas Maes
text: The old SharePoint payroll FAQ keeps coming up in searches and it's wrong about departure holiday pay (says current year only). Can someone get it taken down or flagged?

author: Marie Dubois
text: Meal voucher max is still 8.00 EUR face value, no change for 2026.
